profile.reading: This is a Sandia National Laboratories computing facility in Bernalillo County, New Mexico. Sandia headquarters and largest laboratory, SNL/NM, is located at Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, employing more than 12,000 people. Sandia is owned by the US federal government but privately managed, currently by National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia, a wholly owned subsidiary of Honeywell International, under a contract that began May 1, 2017. Sandia is one of three Department of Energy National Nuclear Security Administration research laboratories, a multimission laboratory spanning approximately 70 activity areas including nuclear deterrence, arms control, nonproliferation, and climate change, organized into five technical areas TA-I through TA-V, and home to the Z Machine, the largest X-ray generator in the world. The lab computing history includes the ASCI Red supercomputer from 1997 to 2006, and it currently houses the Trinity supercomputer and ARM based systems including Astra. As a DOE NNSA national laboratory facility, this serves federally funded national security research rather than commercial purposes.
